QuestInfo.name: [Hilla] The Mysterious Soldiers
QuestInfo.1: The talking was coming from the left side of #bAzwan Lower Floor 2#k. Use the #bportal on the right#k of the Azwan Refugee Zone to get to the Azwan Lower Floor.
QuestInfo.2: A battle broke out without even a word between anyone. One of the soldiers dropped a potion. You should bring it to #bMedina#k. Use the #bportal on the right#k to get to the Azwan Lower Floor.\r\n\r\nThe potion is located on Azwan Lower Floor 2.
QuestInfo.0: You can hear people talking. There must be more #bGrave Robbers#k around. Use the #bportal on the right#k of the Azwan Refugee Zone to get to the Azwan Lower Floor.

0.0: There's someone to the right. Must be Grave Robbers.
